summary: Robust startup build: fixed missing clothing/cache functions, added IndexedDB fallback, safe-mode startup, engine provider fallback, timeouts, and non-blocking cloud updates.
notes: Fixes clearClothingPackCache / missing clothing cache functions.
Local cache/database failures no longer block Studio startup.
Asset/app update failures no longer get reported as a 3D engine failure.
3D engine loading has a second provider fallback and timeouts.
Safe Mode can open the editor while skipping cloud checks.
The launcher now points to app/latest.html, so future editor fixes can be deployed on GitHub without rebuilding the launcher.
